title: Validation of Protocol to Assess Calcium Binding to S. mutans
author: Livia M A Tenuta
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kuqcwvw

steps.title: Reactivate S. mutans Ingbritt 1600
steps.instruction: Reactivate the bacterial cells and verify purity through a series of growth steps.

substeps.instruction: Inoculate 20 uL of glycerol-frozen culture into 10 mL of Brain-Heart Infusion (BHI) broth.
Grow at 37°C, 10% CO2, for 18 h.
Streak the BHI culture on blood agar to obtain isolated colonies and incubate at 37°C, 10% CO2, for 18 h.
Observe purity by colony morphology; store plate at 4°C for up to one month.
Transfer 6-7 isolated colonies to 100 mL of thioglycolate-based medium (2.4% thioglycolate, 1.2% meat extract, 1.5% calcium carbonate, 0.5% glucose) and grow for 18 h.
Verify purity via microscopy of a 10 uL aliquot and Gram staining; store medium at 4°C for up to 7 days.

Transfer 8 mL of the thioglycolate medium to 500 mL of Tryptone-yeast extract (TYB) broth (2.5% tryptone, 1.5% yeast extract, 0.43% potassium hydrogen phosphate, 0.1% magnesium sulfate heptahydrate), pH 7.0, supplemented with 0.25% glucose.
Grow TYB broth at 37°C, 10% CO2, for 18 h.

steps.title: Prepare and Wash Bacterial Pellets
steps.instruction: Harvest the bacteria and perform a series of washes to remove contaminants and chelate calcium.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the TYB culture at 10,000 x g, 4°C, for 10 min; discard supernatant.
Resuspend pellets in 100 mL of 0.05 M PIPES buffer, pH 7.0, at 4°C (split into 2 x 50-mL tubes).
For each 50 mL tube: vortex mix for 30 s, sonicate at 7 W for 1 min, centrifuge at 10,000 x g, 4°C for 10 min, and discard supernatant.
Resuspend in 50 mL of 0.01 M EDTA solution, 4°C; vortex mix for 30 s, sonicate at 7 W for 1 min, centrifuge at 10,000 x g, 4°C for 10 min, and discard supernatant.
Resuspend in 50 mL of 0.05 M PIPES buffer, pH 7.0, at 4°C; vortex mix for 30 s, sonicate at 7 W for 1 min, centrifuge at 10,000 g, 4°C for 10 min, and discard supernatant.
Resuspend in approximately 10 mL of 0.05 M PIPES buffer, pH 7.0, at 4°C and vortex mix for 30 s.

steps.title: Harvest and Weigh Bacterial Pellets
steps.instruction: Aliquoted the suspension to obtain specific pellet weights.

substeps.instruction: Transfer aliquots of approximately 1.4 mL (for ~120 mg pellet) or 0.9 mL (for ~80 mg pellet) to pre-weighted 1.5-mL microcentrifuge tubes.
Centrifuge at 21,000 x g, 4°C for 5 min.
Carefully discard supernatant under a microscope using a vacuum aspiration system and glass micropipettes.
Repeat the centrifugation and aspiration steps if necessary.
Weigh the microcentrifuge tubes to determine the final pellet weight.

steps.title: Calcium Binding Treatment
steps.instruction: Incubate bacterial pellets with calcium treatment solutions.

substeps.instruction: Add treatment solution (1 or 10 mM Ca from CaCl2 in 0.05 M PIPES buffer, pH 7.0) at 37°C to each tube.
For 1 mM Ca: use 15 µL/mg bacteria; for 10 mM Ca: use 7.5 µL/mg bacteria.
Vortex mix for 30 s and maintain at 37°C for 60 min in a dry block.
Centrifuge at 21,000 x g, 4°C for 5 min.
Collect the supernatant in a new tube for calcium concentration determination.
Carefully discard remaining supernatant remnants under a microscope using a vacuum aspiration system and glass micropipettes.
Store final bacterial pellets and supernatants at -20°C if not processed immediately.

steps.title: Acid Extraction of Bound Calcium
steps.instruction: Extract bound calcium from the bacterial pellets using HCl.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.5 M HCl to each pellet at a proportion of 0.1 mL/10 mg.
Vortex mix until the pellet is completely suspended.
Maintain under agitation in a rotating mixer for 3 h at room temperature, vortexing every 30 min.
Centrifuge at 10,000 x g for 3 min at room temperature.
Collect the supernatant for calcium measurement.

steps.title: Determine Calcium Concentration via Arsenazo III
steps.instruction: Measure calcium in both the PIPES supernatant and the HCl extract using a 96-well microplate reader at 650 nm.

substeps.instruction: For HCl extract (Standard Curve): Mix 100 µL purified water, 25 µL 0.5 M NaOH, 25 µL Ca standard (0.075 to 1.2 mM) in 0.5 M HCl, and 150 µL Arsenazo III reagent.
For HCl extract (Samples): Mix 100 µL purified water, 25 µL 0.5 M NaOH, 0-15 µL 0.5 M HCl (depending on treatment), 10-25 µL sample, and 150 µL Arsenazo III reagent.
For PIPES supernatant (Standard Curve): Mix 0-150 µL 0.05 M PIPES buffer, 0-150 µL 0.3 mM Ca stock (to achieve 0.025 to 0.3 mM), and 150 µL Arsenazo III reagent.
For PIPES supernatant (Samples): Mix 0-135 µL 0.05 M PIPES buffer (10x dilution for 10 mM samples), 15-150 µL sample, and 150 µL Arsenazo III reagent.
Read absorbance at 650 nm and calculate concentration using linear regression.
